source.title: Efficiency Is Priority One
source.description:
Actually, I just gave myself an idea. You see, the biggest problem when workin' with elementium is keeping the forge hot enough. If I had something that I could use to keep the fire goin' full strength longer, I wouldn't have to waste as much time as I do stoking it.

If you can find me a magical means to keep my forge hot, I could free up a bit of my time for side hustles like your little request. Now go, beat it. See what you can rustle up for me.
source.objective: Find a suitable power source to keep Master Elemental Shaper Krixix's elementium forge run more efficiently.
source.progress: What are you talkin' to me for? Scram.
source.completion:
Wow! This is perfect!

You'd think that Vick could have used some of that magic of his to fix this problem for me, being the son of Deathwing and all. Between you and me though, he's got that "complacent second generation management" energy. Useless.

At any rate... let's get crackin' on this.
